name: Jar with Dragons Pursuing Flaming Jewels
material: procelain with wucai (five color) overglaze enamel decoration
dimensions: Diameter: 14.7 cm (5 13/16 in.); Overall: 12.9 cm (5 1/16 in.)
summary: The exterior of this jar is ornamented with two rampant five-clawed dragons boldly drawn in rouge de fer.
